```{r analyze BLASTN ouput - cyanotoxin genes}

#Make list of blastn result outputs
blastn_assemblies_list <-  system("ls blast/output/cyanoToxin/blastn/assemblies/*.tsv", intern=TRUE) 

#Include only files with results in list
blastn_assemblies_list_results <- blastn_assemblies_list[file.size(blastn_assemblies_list) > 0]

#Bind rows of all contig blastn results
blastn_assemblies_results_vroom <- vroom(blastn_assemblies_list_results, col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE, delim = "\t")

#Add column names - corresponding to blast output flag -outfmt '6 std qcovs stitle'
colnames(blastn_assemblies_results_vroom) <- c("qseqid", "sseqid", "pident", "length", "mismatch", "gapopen", "qstart", "qend", "sstart", "send", "evalue", "bitscore", "qcovs", "stitle", "qlen") #added qlen Sept 26, 2024 for Buoyancy analysis

#Column name reference: https://www.metagenomics.wiki/tools/blast/blastn-output-format-6
#1.  qseqid      query or source (e.g., gene) sequence id
#2.  sseqid      subject  or target (e.g., reference genome) sequence id
#3.  pident      percentage of identical matches
#4.  length      alignment length (sequence overlap)
#5.  mismatch    number of mismatches
#6.  gapopen     number of gap openings
#7.  qstart      start of alignment in query
#8.  qend        end of alignment in query
#9.  sstart      start of alignment in subject
#10. send        end of alignment in subject
#11. evalue      expect value
#12. bitscore    bit score
#13. qcovs       query coverage per subject
#14. stitle      subject title
#15. qlen        query length

#Make column for general toxin target id, toxin gene target, and sample ids
blastn_assemblies_results_vroom_add <- blastn_assemblies_results_vroom %>% mutate(target = substr(sseqid, 1, 3),
                                                                                  gene_target = substr(sseqid, 1,4),
                                                                                  SampleID = qseqid %>% str_extract("samp_.*_") %>% str_sub(end = -2))

#Combine BLASTN results and sample metadata from GLAMR
#Call Sample_table from 1.) Setup, convert latitude/longitude values to numeric, add new column with sampling year
GLAMR_assemblies_hits <- left_join(blastn_assemblies_results_vroom_add, GLAMR_sample_table_SC, by = "SampleID") %>%
  mutate(
    lat = as.numeric(as.character(lat)),
    lon = as.numeric(as.character(lon)),
    year = as.integer(str_remove(collection_date, "-.*"))
  )

#Sort to get lowest e-value hit for each contig
GLAMR_assemblies_hits_filt = GLAMR_assemblies_hits %>%
  mutate(qseqid_gene = paste0(qseqid, "_", gene_target)) %>%
  arrange(qseqid_gene, evalue) %>%                        # sort the data by 'evalue' in ascending order for each qseqid
  group_by(qseqid_gene) %>%
  filter(row_number() == 1) %>%                      # keep only one row for each qseqid (lowest evalue)
  ungroup()

GLAMR_assemblies_hits_filt %>% distinct(SampleID)  #All 5 sample assemblies hit to cyanotoxin gene target(s) of interest - November 13, 2025

```

```{r qc BLASTN hits - 50% cover 80% ID}

#Make table of cyanotoxin db gene lengths
#First import blast database
blastdb_cyanoToxin_read <- readDNAStringSet(filepath = "blast/database/nucl/blastdbcyanoToxin.fasta") 

#Make a table with corresponding 50% length cutoff for each sequence
names_width_table <- data.frame(
  subject = names(blastdb_cyanoToxin_read),
  ref_width = width(blastdb_cyanoToxin_read)
) %>%
  mutate(cutoff_width = (ref_width * .5) %>% round(.))

#Filter blast hits for 50% reference gene length cutoff & 80% percent identity
blastn_cyanotoxin_assemblies_unique_gene_QC <- GLAMR_assemblies_hits_filt %>%
  inner_join(names_width_table, by = c("stitle" = "subject")) %>%
  filter(length >= cutoff_width) %>%
  filter(pident >= 80) 

#These results provide the best hit for each unique cyanotoxin gene target and metagenomic contig
blastn_cyanotoxin_assemblies_unique_gene_QC_select <- blastn_cyanotoxin_assemblies_unique_gene_QC %>%
      select(qseqid, sseqid, SampleID, pident, length, qlen, qstart, qend, sstart, send, evalue, gene_target, ref_width, cutoff_width, lat, lon, SampleName, collection_date, geo_loc_name) 

# Save results
##write.csv(blastn_cyanotoxin_assemblies_unique_gene_QC_select, file ="data/notebook1/blastn_cyanotoxin_assemblies_results_50cov80id.csv")

```

```{bash create phlyogenomic tree}

cd /geomicro/data2/pdenuyl2/CIGLR_bioinformatics/2025/StClair_manuscript/GToTree/GToTree_final
conda deactivate
comics -i sid
cp -r /usr/local/lib/GToTree-1.7.05/hmm_sets/ ./
export GToTree_HMM_dir=hmm_sets/
export TAXONKIT_DB=ncbi-taxdump
GToTree -f fasta_files_mediumv4.txt -H Cyanobacteria -t -m genome_to_id_map_mediumv4.tsv -j 10 -o Tree_Output_Mediumv4
```

```{r create clinker figure for sxt contigs}

#Clean up name from blast results above
GLAMR_assemblies_sxt_hits <- blastn_cyanotoxin_assemblies_unique_gene_QC_select

assembly_paths_clinker <- tibble(sample = GLAMR_assemblies_sxt_hits$SampleID) %>%
                mutate(read_path = str_glue("/geomicro/data2/kiledal/GLAMR/data/omics/metagenomes/{sample}/assembly/megahit_noNORM/final.contigs.renamed.fa"),
                       new_path = str_glue("/geomicro/data2/pdenuyl2/CIGLR_bioinformatics/2025/StClair_manuscript/clinker/contig_compare/megahit_noNORM/{sample}_final.contigs.renamed.fa")) %>%
                filter(sample %in% GLAMR_assemblies_sxt_hits$SampleID) %>%
                distinct(.)

#symbolic link read_paths
##file.symlink(assembly_paths_clinker$read_path, assembly_paths_clinker$new_path)

##################
#Extract contigs#
#################

for (sample in GLAMR_assemblies_sxt_hits$SampleID) {
  
output_fasta <- paste0("clinker/contig_compare/contigs_oi/", sample, "_contigs_oi.fa")

input_fasta <- paste0("../clinker/contig_compare/megahit_noNORM/", sample, "_final.contigs.renamed.fa")

# Read the FASTA file using Biostrings
fasta_data <- readDNAStringSet(input_fasta, format = "fasta")

# Convert to tibble for easier manipulation
fasta_df <- tibble(
  name = names(fasta_data),
  sequence = as.character(fasta_data))

# Make list of contig names to filter
contigs_to_filter <- GLAMR_assemblies_sxt_hits %>%
                                filter(SampleID == sample) %>%
                                select(qseqid)

# Extract the contig of interest 
contigs_of_interest <- fasta_df %>%
  filter(name %in% contigs_to_filter$qseqid)

# Convert the all contigs back to a DNAStringSet
contigs_to_write <- DNAStringSet(contigs_of_interest$sequence)
names(contigs_to_write) <- contigs_of_interest$name

# Write the contig to the new FASTA file
writeXStringSet(contigs_to_write, output_fasta)

}
```
